title: Pixelball Crosshair
description: Change your crosshair to a cute little Pixelball!
body:
Change your crosshair to a cute little Pixelball!

_Please note: check the modpack for an existing crosshair mod, delete it and add the Pixelball custom crosshair (or the original that comes with Pixelmon will override it)._

![PixelBall Crosshair in action!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ec1aaac394c9305523e5fc2bbad86efaba88400f.jpeg)

Any issues at all please let me know, thank you! Enjoy!
